judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: No-claim row. The element is the 'Place a Notice' link in the 'Top Links' navigation, with a visually hidden 'Opens in new window' suffix, leading to https://secure.irishnews.com/notice. The link text alone states its purpose (placing a notice in the paper); the live destination answers 200 with the title 'Family Notices - IrishNews', which matches what the text promises. No other link in the snapshot shares its name (the neighbouring link is 'Notices'), so the shared-name rule (R1) does not apply. I looked for a reason it could fail and found none, so it meets 2.4.4 and Rampa was right to report nothing. The live HTML has the same anchor, href, target and hidden text as the snapshot, so the capture does not differ.
